--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_merge_mapping_options.py
@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+from collections import OrderedDict
+
+import jmespath
+from jmespath import functions
+
+
+class MarkerDict(dict):
+    pass
+
+
+class Inherited(functions.Functions):
+    pass
+
+
+class Overridden(functions.Functions):
+    @functions.signature({'types': ['object'], 'variadic': True})
+    def _func_merge(self, *args):
+        return {'override': True}
+
+
+def test_public_and_compiled_merge_use_configured_mapping():
+    data = {'a': {'x': 1, 'y': 2}, 'b': {'x': 3, 'z': 4}}
+    compiled = jmespath.compile('merge(a, b)')
+    for mapping in (OrderedDict, MarkerDict):
+        options = jmespath.Options(dict_cls=mapping)
+        for result in (jmespath.search('merge(a, b)', data, options),
+                       compiled.search(data, options)):
+            assert type(result) is mapping
+            assert result == {'x': 3, 'y': 2, 'z': 4}
+            assert list(result) == ['x', 'y', 'z']
+    assert data == {'a': {'x': 1, 'y': 2}, 'b': {'x': 3, 'z': 4}}
+    assert type(compiled.search(data)) is dict
+
+
+def test_inherited_merge_does_not_leak_mapping_options():
+    provider = Inherited()
+    data = {'a': {'x': 1}, 'b': {'y': 2}}
+    compiled = jmespath.compile('merge(a, b)')
+    for mapping in (MarkerDict, None, OrderedDict, None):
+        options = jmespath.Options(dict_cls=mapping, custom_functions=provider)
+        result = compiled.search(data, options)
+        assert type(result) is (dict if mapping is None else mapping)
+        assert result == {'x': 1, 'y': 2}
+
+
+def test_merge_inside_expression_reference_uses_mapping():
+    options = jmespath.Options(dict_cls=MarkerDict)
+    result = jmespath.search('map(&merge(@, `{"extra":1}`), rows)',
+                             {'rows': [{'a': 2}, {}]}, options)
+    assert result == [{'a': 2, 'extra': 1}, {'extra': 1}]
+    assert all(type(item) is MarkerDict for item in result)
+
+
+def test_custom_merge_override_is_not_rewrapped():
+    options = jmespath.Options(dict_cls=MarkerDict,
+                               custom_functions=Overridden())
+    result = jmespath.search('merge(`{}`)', {}, options)
+    assert type(result) is dict
+    assert result == {'override': True}

This must work through both `jmespath.search` and a compiled expression's `search`, including a merge evaluated inside an expression reference. With no `dict_cls`, merge must still return a plain dict. Preserve merge's overwrite behavior and leave its arguments unmodified. The inherited built-in merge on a custom `Functions` subclass must honor the option too, but an explicitly overridden custom merge must keep control of its own return value. Reusing one custom-functions instance across searches with different options must not leak the mapping choice between searches. Deliver a unified diff against production files only.
